stops.name: Wolfgangsee
stops.detail: Lake Wolfgangsee is shared by two provinces: SalzburgerLand and Upper Austria. In the Salzkammergut, it is one of those swimming lakes you do not simply visit, but truly experience. It is the landscape around the lake, the many ways to enjoy the outdoors, and the way of life of the people who call this place home: relaxed, welcoming and guided by a fine sense of what feels good. They call it 'Alles gschmah' - when everything feels just right and follows its own rhythm.
